corrections.why: 28N-6E-23 is a land survey code from the Central US Lookouts page, not an agency. That page says the Conservation Commission erected the tower in 1949; no source read says who ran it afterwards.

sources.title: Wisconsin Lookouts - Forest Fire Lookout Association

notes_for_editor: Thin record. The only history for this tower is one line on the Central US Lookouts page (1949, erected by the Wisconsin Conservation Commission). The state page's 1928 clipping is background about the state tower program, not about this tower. The FFLA list gives gone status and coordinates; the OSM node gives the name and observation tag only. Two searches found nothing else specific to this tower. The record's agency field holds the survey code 28N, so a correction is proposed. The FFLA name Hardwood Hill appears only on the FFLA list; the Central US Lookouts page calls it Marathon. Not in the sources read, so it needs a citation before use: the Conservation Commission was later succeeded by the Department of Natural Resources.
